title: Two-tank reader path: setup.md and configuration.md state the activation rule differently, and neither matches the code
claim: A user configuring two-tank storage reads in docs/setup.md (Quick setup, 'Wood buffer tank' row) that a throttling mixing valve plus the wood-tank probes switch the two-tank physics on, with no mention of the two-zone condition; docs/configuration.md (layout catalog) says valve + two zones + the wood-tank TOP sensor ('the switch for the two-tank model'). The code (ThermalParameters.topology_layout) needs valve + two zones + a top OR bottom probe (and the wood furnace on). On a 16-cell grid, setup.md's rule disagrees with the model on 3 cells (every single-zone house with a valve and a probe: the doc promises two-tank physics, the model runs single_tank_valve), configuration.md's on 1 (bottom probe only: the model runs two_tank_4way, the doc says it does not). Quick setup's 'Two-zone house: no' answer writes two_zone_mode=off (quick_setup.py), so a Quick-setup reader reaches the 3-cell case directly.

perturbation: --perturb patches ThermalParameters.topology_layout in memory to drop the two-zone condition (valve + probe -> two_tank_4way): setup_md_mismatch 3 -> 0, configuration_md_mismatch 1 -> 4 (executed).
metric_definition: Cells of the 16-cell grid (two_zone_mode on/off x valve manual/none x wood probes none/top/bottom/both, wood furnace on) where a doc's stated activation rule disagrees with two_tank_modelled.
phenomenon_property: Every reader doc that states when the two-tank model runs states the same rule as ThermalParameters.topology_layout / const.topology_layout_valid (valve, two zones, any wood-tank probe, wood furnace on).
seam_rule: grep -n -i 'two-tank\|two tanks\|wood tank top sensor' README.md docs/*.md
proposed_fix_scope: Docs only: state the one rule (valve + two zones + a wood-tank probe, top or bottom) in setup.md's Wood buffer tank row and configuration.md's layout catalog bullet and table; link setup.md to the catalog section.
